title: finding(i18n): `I18nProvider`'s "force re-render" after `loadLanguage` is a no-op — `setLanguage(currentLang)` sets the state it already holds, so app translations loaded after mount are not shown until something else re-renders
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from objectui#10349's dev report (PR objectui#10381, `out_of_scope_findings`, class a). ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Fact

`packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx` holds `const [language, setLanguage] = useState(i18nInstance.language || 'en')` (`:585` at `origin/main`). Its `loadLanguage` effect adds the loaded app bundle with `i18nInstance.addResourceBundle(currentLang, 'translation', resources, true, true)`, then runs:

```ts
// Force re-render so components pick up newly loaded translations
setLanguage(currentLang);
```

(`:672`–`:673`). `currentLang` is `i18nInstance.language || 'en'`, the value the state already holds on first load. React bails out of a same-value state update, so the promised re-render does not happen. Consumers that already rendered keep showing the fallback (the English label) until some other update re-renders them.

The seat read both sites on `origin/main`.

## Measured (the objectui#10349 dev, a temporary probe, not committed)

- Mount: `I18nProvider loadLanguage={loadLanguage} config={{ defaultLanguage: 'zh-CN', detectBrowserLanguage: false }} persistLanguage={false}`, with objectui#10381's fixed starter loader over a spec payload (`crm_lead` label `线索`, field `name` label `名称`).
- The loader was called once, with `zh-CN`. The bundle carried `app = { objects: { crm_lead: { label: '线索' } }, fields: { crm_lead: { name: '名称' } } }`.
- The consumer rendered once and read `Lead`. `findByText('线索')` timed out at 3000 ms.
- After one forced state bump, it read `线索` (2 renders).

`apps/console/src/main.tsx` wires `I18nProvider loadLanguage={loadLanguage}` the same way. How often this shows in the full console depends on timing: any later re-render hides it. ⛔ Not measured in the full app.

## Seam

`i18n:I18nProvider` `loadLanguage` effect → every `useObjectLabel` / `t()` consumer mounted before the app bundle arrives.

## ⛔ Not claimed

- ⛔ No fix is chosen. Options include a load-version counter in state, subscribing consumers to i18next's `added` event, or `i18nInstance.reloadResources`-style notification.
- The sibling call at `:653` (`setLanguage(i18nInstance.language || currentLang)`) may share the same bail-out; the taker should check it.

## Dedupe words

`I18nProvider loadLanguage no re-render` · `setLanguage same language bail out` · `app translations loaded after mount not shown` · `force re-render no-op provider`
